examples.chinese: A：你要哪種筆？ B：我要鉛筆。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào nǎ zhǒng bǐ? B: Wǒ yào qiānbǐ.
examples.english: A: What kind of pen do you want? B: I want a pencil.

examples.chinese: A:你要哪種筆？ B:我要鉛筆。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào nǎ zhǒng bǐ? B: Wǒ yào qiānbǐ.
examples.english: A: What kind of pen do you want? B: I want a pencil.

examples.chinese: 我有兩枝鉛筆。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī qiānbǐ.
examples.english: I have two pencils.

examples.chinese: A:你要哪種筆？ B:我要鉛筆。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào nǎ zhǒng bǐ? B: Wǒ yào qiānbǐ.
examples.english: A: What kind of pen do you want? B: I want a pencil.

examples.chinese: 這種小鉛筆怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiǎo qiānbǐ zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: What do you think about this type of small pencil?

examples.chinese: 這本書有豐富的內容及生動的鉛筆畫，是吸引讀者購買的主要原因。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǒu fēngfù de nèiróng jí shēngdòng de qiānbǐhuà, shì xīyǐn dúzhě gòumǎi de zhǔyào yuányīn.
examples.english: This book has rich content and lively pencil drawings, which are the main reasons that attract readers to buy it.

items.wordHook: 鉛(lead) + 筆(pen) → the lead pen: 鉛筆(pencil).

examples.chinese: 我跟她不太熟，所以不知道她喜歡喝什麼茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā bù tài shú, suǒyǐ bù zhīdào tā xǐhuān hē shénme chá.
examples.english: I'm not very familiar with her, so I don't know what tea she likes to drink.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我參加了愛心服務社以後，想法比以前更成熟了。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"香蕉還沒成熟的時候是綠色的，等變成黃色就熟了。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cānjiā le àixīn fúwùshè yǐhòu, xiǎngfǎ bǐ yǐqián gèng chéngshú le. Xiāngjiāo hái méi chéngshú de shíhou shì lǜsè de, děng biàn chéng huángsè jiù shú le.
examples.english: After I joined the volunteer service club, my thinking has become more mature than before. When bananas are not yet ripe, they are green; when they turn yellow, they are ripe.

examples.chinese: 剛進公司的員工對環境比較陌生，對工作內容也不熟悉，多多少少需要協助。
examples.pinyin: Gāng jìn gōngsī de yuángōng duì huánjìng bǐjiào mòshēng, duì gōngzuò nèiróng yě bù shúxī, duōduōshǎoshǎo xūyào xiézhù.
examples.english: Employees who have just joined the company are relatively unfamiliar with the environment and are also not familiar with the work content, so they more or less need assistance.

examples.chinese: 如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。
examples.pinyin: Rú xiǎng tōngguò nà jiā qǐyè de miànshì, jiù děi xiān shúxī tāmen de chǎnpǐn tèsè yǔ xiāoshòu fāngshì.
examples.english: If you want to pass that company's interview, you must first be familiar with their product features and sales methods.

examples.chinese: 你別看她一臉害羞的樣子，在熟人面前她可是很開朗的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié kàn tā yī liǎn hàixiū de yàngzi, zài shúrén miànqián tā kěshì hěn kāilǎng de.
examples.english: Don't judge her by her shy appearance; in front of acquaintances she is actually very cheerful.

examples.chinese: 她在電子工廠上班，難怪拆機器的技術非常熟練。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài diànzǐ gōngchǎng shàngbān, nánguài chāi jīqì de jìshù fēicháng shúliàn.
examples.english: She works at an electronics factory, no wonder her skill in disassembling machines is very proficient.

examples.chinese: 在人生地不熟的地方旅行時，如有當地人帶路，就可以節省不少時間。
examples.pinyin: Zài rénshēngdìbùshú de dìfāng lǚxíng shí, rú yǒu dāngdìrén dàilù, jiù kěyǐ jiéshěng bùshǎo shíjiān.
examples.english: When traveling in a place where you are unfamiliar with the people and surroundings, if a local leads the way, you can save quite a bit of time.

examples.chinese: 擲標槍、射箭、開槍(to shoot)需要的技巧都不同，想熟練就得多連練習。
examples.pinyin: Zhì biāoqiāng, shèjiàn, kāiqiāng xūyào de jìqiǎo dōu bùtóng, xiǎng shúliàn jiù děi duō liànxí.
examples.english: The skills required for javelin throwing, archery, and shooting a gun are all different; if you want to become proficient, you must practice more.

examples.chinese: 這本書是這位作家的代表作品，研究他的人都很熟悉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì zhè wèi zuòjiā de dàibiǎo zuòpǐn, yánjiū tā de rén dōu hěn shúxī.
examples.english: This book is this author's representative work; those who study him are all very familiar with it.

items.wordHook: When the aroma of a 孰(ripe) stew peaks over blazing embers of bright 灬(fire), every portion is thoroughly 熟(well-cooked).

examples.chinese: 這次去荷蘭旅行的費用很高，因為車票很貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qù Hélán lǚxíng de fèiyòng hěn gāo, yīnwèi chēpiào hěn guì.
examples.english: The cost of this trip to the Netherlands is very high because the train tickets are very expensive.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"到國外生活以前，得先找租房子的資料。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"山本良介覺得在台灣生活的費用(生活費)不太高，日本的比較高。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Dào guówài shēnghuó yǐqián, děi xiān zhǎo zū fángzi de zīliào. Shānběn Liángjiè juéde zài Táiwān shēnghuó de fèiyòng (shēnghuófèi) bù tài gāo, Rìběn de bǐjiào gāo.
examples.english: Before going abroad to live, you must first find information about renting a place. Yamamoto Ryosuke feels that the cost of living in Taiwan is not very high; Japan's is higher.

examples.chinese: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.
examples.english: Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 打破你們的碗盤是我的錯，我會對自己的行為負責，付你們這個費用。
examples.pinyin: Dǎpò nǐmen de wǎnpán shì wǒ de cuò, wǒ huì duì zìjǐ de xíngwéi fùzé, fù nǐmen zhège fèiyòng.
examples.english: Breaking your dishes was my fault; I will take responsibility for my behavior and pay you this fee.

examples.chinese: 這家公司雖然要求員工得穿西裝上班，但費用全是公司負擔的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán yāoqiú yuángōng děi chuān xīzhuāng shàngbān, dàn fèiyòng quán shì gōngsī fùdān de.
examples.english: Although this company requires employees to wear suits to work, the cost is entirely borne by the company.

examples.chinese: 我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái. Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english: Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it. Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 學習外國語言時最好能找位專業的老師，好改正自己的錯誤。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí wàiguó yǔyán shí zuìhǎo néng zhǎo wèi zhuānyè de lǎoshī, hǎo gǎizhèng zìjǐ de cuòwù.
examples.english: When learning a foreign language, it's best to find a professional teacher so as to correct your own mistakes.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有不小心發生錯誤的時候，不需要取笑別人。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng cuòwù de shíhou, bù xūyào qǔxiào biérén.
examples.english: Everyone has times when they accidentally make mistakes; there is no need to make fun of others.

examples.chinese: 仔細地思考是為了防止做出錯誤的決定。
examples.pinyin: Zǐxì de sīkǎo shì wèile fángzhǐ zuò chū cuòwù de juédìng.
examples.english: Careful thinking is to prevent making wrong decisions.

examples.chinese: 錯誤通常來自粗心，因此無論事情大小都該用心處理。
examples.pinyin: Cuòwù tōngcháng láizì cūxīn, yīncǐ wúlùn shìqíng dàxiǎo dōu gāi yòngxīn chǔlǐ.
examples.english: Mistakes usually come from carelessness, so no matter how big or small the matter is, it should be handled with care.

items.wordHook: Combining 錯(a mistake) and 誤(error): 錯誤 means mistake.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的年輕人愛喝咖啡，因此很多地方都是咖啡店比茶館多。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de niánqīngrén ài hē kāfēi, yīncǐ hěn duō dìfāng dōu shì kāfēidiàn bǐ cháguǎn duō.
examples.english: Young people in Taiwan love to drink coffee, so in many places there are more coffee shops than teahouses.

examples.chinese: 我來臺灣，算起來才三個月而已，卻已去過十幾家茶館了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lái Táiwān, suàn qǐlái cái sān ge yuè éryǐ, què yǐ qùguo shí jǐ jiā cháguǎn le.
examples.english: In total, it has only been three months since I came to Taiwan, yet I have already been to more than ten tea houses.

examples.chinese: A:你要不要跟我一起去茶館喝杯茶？ B:與其去喝茶，我倒想去外面走走，看看花草樹木。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào bù yào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù cháguǎn hē bēi chá? B: Yǔqí qù hē chá, wǒ dào xiǎng qù wàimiàn zǒuzǒu, kànkan huā cǎo shùmù.
examples.english: A: Do you want to go to the teahouse with me to have a cup of tea? B: Rather than go drink tea, I'd actually like to go for a walk outside and look at the flowers, grass, and trees.

examples.chinese: 錢先生買了一只上百萬的鑽石戒指，當成跟女友求婚的禮物。
examples.pinyin: Qián xiānsheng mǎi le yì zhī shàng bǎi wàn de zuànshí jièzhǐ, dāngchéng gēn nǚyǒu qiúhūn de lǐwù.
examples.english: Mr. Qian bought a diamond ring worth over a million, considering it a gift to propose to his girlfriend.

examples.chinese: 這兩個國家因為搶石油資源，而把對方當成了敵人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge guójiā yīnwèi qiǎng shíyóu zīyuán, ér bǎ duìfāng dāngchéng le dírén.
examples.english: These two countries, because they are fighting over oil resources, have regarded each other as enemies.

examples.chinese: 鵝一看到陌生人就會大叫，所以鄉村裡有人把鵝當成狗來看家(kānjiā， to guard the house)。
examples.pinyin: É yī kàndào mòshēngrén jiù huì dàjiào, suǒyǐ xiāngcūn lǐ yǒu rén bǎ é dāngchéng gǒu lái kānjiā.
examples.english: As soon as a goose sees a stranger, it will honk loudly, so in the countryside some people treat geese like dogs to guard the house.

examples.chinese: 有些學校將教育當成商品來買賣，但也有人不支持。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē xuéxiào jiāng jiàoyù dàngchéng shāngpǐn lái mǎimài, dàn yě yǒu rén bù zhīchí.
examples.english: Some schools treat education as a commodity to buy and sell, but there are also people who do not support this.

examples.chinese: 我好友昨天和女朋友分手了，這幾天心情很糟，我得去安慰安慰他。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎoyǒu zuótiān hé nǚpéngyǒu fēnshǒu le, zhè jǐ tiān xīnqíng hěn zāo, wǒ děi qù ānwèi ānwèi tā.
examples.english: My good friend broke up with his girlfriend yesterday; he's been in a terrible mood these past few days, so I need to go comfort him.

examples.chinese: 迷信的人老是相信一些不真實的迷信，例如：黑貓會帶來不好的運氣、送傘給情人就會分手什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Míxìn de rén lǎoshì xiāngxìn yīxiē bù zhēnshí de míxìn, lìrú: hēimāo huì dàilái bù hǎo de yùnqì, sòng sǎn gěi qíngrén jiù huì fēnshǒu shénme de.
examples.english: Superstitious people always believe in some untrue superstitions, for example: black cats will bring bad luck, giving an umbrella to a lover will lead to a breakup, and so on.

examples.chinese: 情侶之間如果無法相信彼此，很容易就分手了。
examples.pinyin: Qínglǚ zhījiān rúguǒ wúfǎ xiāngxìn bǐcǐ, hěn róngyì jiù fēnshǒu le.
examples.english: If couples cannot trust each other, they easily break up.

examples.chinese: 賽跑前要先做點兒運動，免得受傷。
examples.pinyin: Sàipǎo qián yào xiān zuò diǎnr yùndòng, miǎnde shòushāng.
examples.english: Before racing, you should do some exercise first, so as to avoid getting hurt.

examples.chinese: 這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù. Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english: In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds. The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

items.wordHook: One way (樣) for all: 一樣 means 'the same'.
Linked like 一(one) continuous chain where events 連(join) in a row: 一連 means in succession.
a 亻(person) leans back on a 木(tree) → taking a 休(rest).
A 扌(hand) points at an 兆(omen) sign, choosing which path to take → 挑(select).
Combining 現(appear) and 象(elephant): 現象 means phenomenon.
a 竹(bamboo) takes a 夭(young) bend → breaking into a 笑(smile).
錢(money) + 包(wrap) → the wrap for your money: 錢包 is a wallet.
